name: register_context
title: Register context
description: Attach an external context source to a meeting: an external transcript with speaker names (Notion AI minutes, Zoom / Meet / Teams transcript), a chat log, a document, a URL or free text. Exactly one of `content` (inline text), `url` (http/https) or `file_path` (absolute local path of a regular, non-hidden file of at most 16 MiB; `~` is not expanded) must be given. The raw payload is stored verbatim in the bundle (context/sources/<context_id>.json) as the source of truth; `status` reports `stored` (raw only) or `parsed` (recognised format, parsed into transcript source `ext-<context_id>` usable by get_transcript and alignment). With auto_regenerate=true a `regenerate` job is enqueued so the new context takes part in alignment and minutes generation; its job_id is returned. `scope` is the scope selector (default deny: a scoped meeting needs its scope in the request). `request_id` is the client-generated idempotency key: repeating the call returns the same context_id. On failure returns an error_envelope (isError=true) with code: not_found (unknown meeting, or file_path does not exist), scope_denied (the request does not cover the meeting's scope), invalid_argument (none or more than one of content / url / file_path, a file_path that is relative, hidden, not a regular file or too large, or a payload that does not fit source_type), busy (a job is queued / running for the meeting — nothing is stored in that case — or auto_regenerate while the meeting is still recording), policy_violation (auto_regenerate with a provider not allowed by external_send_policy), internal.

source_type.description: Kind of source. Transcript kinds (notion_ai_minutes, zoom_transcript, meet_transcript, teams_transcript) may be parsed into a transcript source; chat_log / document / text / url / file are stored as context for minutes generation.

content.description: Inline text payload (the transcript / document body). Mutually exclusive with url and file_path.

url.description: http(s) URL of the source. Stored as a reference; fetched only when the meeting's external_send_policy allows it. Mutually exclusive with content and file_path.

file_path.description: Absolute path of a local file whose content is copied into the bundle. Mutually exclusive with content and url.

label.description: Optional human-readable label shown in get_meeting.contexts.

auto_regenerate.description: Enqueue a regenerate job after storing (default false).

status.description: stored = raw payload saved only; parsed = also parsed into transcript source ext-<context_id>.

job_id.description: Present when auto_regenerate=true: the enqueued regenerate job.

input.content:
岡村: では定例を始めます。
田中: 先週の進捗から共有します。
